item.title: Your Phone Is an Entire Computer
item.description:
📝 Apple would like to have everyone believe these devices are fundamentally different, that the iPhone must be locked in the name of "user safety", because clicking on links is dangerous. These restrictions are boons for corporate and sovereign powers that would like to control what you can do with your computing devices. The narrative that mobile devices are somehow different enough to warrant restrictions on software loading mainly benefits actors that don’t have the average person’s best interests at heart.
🔗 Read more: https://medhir.com/blog/your-phone-is-an-entire-computer

item.title: Why the militaries are scrambling to create their own Starlink
item.description:
📝 Both Ukraine and Russia have used Starlink since the 2022 invasion, with reports suggesting that Russia has guided attack drones with it. China is also building the Guowang network, which will have 13,000 satellites, but currently has fewer than 200, and the Qianfan constellation, which is also still in the early stages of construction. “Of course, the Chinese will have one, and do have one [of current lesser size], so they will have secure satellite digital communications in any future conflict,” he says.
